biography:
AJ leverages 15+ years of experience focused on solving complex problems, mission critical negotiations, location strategy, team development strategic supply/demand planning, and innovative thought leadership. Currently focused on location strategy and acquisition to build mission critical cloud infrastructure, he excels in delivering results across matrixed organizations.  He previously built a team from the early stages to a dedicated team of 18 technical personnel focused on land acquisition delivering the company with several billions of dollars in assets to support various cloud platforms.  Prior to work on infrastructure projects he developed a 10-year redevelopment strategy inclusive of dynamic supply/demand and financial modeling scenarios, forecast setting, and while overseeing transaction management and providing functional continuity between strategic planning, master planning, and tactical execution.  AJ is known for seeing the big picture which is supported by the technical details in a manner which ensures cross-functional groups are pulling in the same direction. Specialties include: Location Strategy, site acquisition, physical infrastructure, due diligence, portfolio optimization, financial modeling, data-driven problem solving, customer-focused, executive presentations
